comments.body:
Quest name: World's Most Extravagant
Quest location: Stockholm Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Archaeology, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: Black-Lipped Pearl Oyster discovery (from "Shell that makes treasure" quest) + Cleopatra's Brooch discovery (from "Sophistication and beauty" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Archaeologist's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
